items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Arthur Lee Simpkins was with the Chicago band.

ctx.x: One thing that you had mentioned earlier, that you said you'd refer back to, was the vocalist that you had with your band, Arthur Lee Simpkins.

Yes. Now Arthur Lee Simpkins was with the Chicago band. We called him Georgia Boy. He was actually from Georgia. This guy was internationally known because he later become a great -- what do you call it? -- a lyric tenor? And he toured Europe. He sang in different languages. Oh, six or seven different languages. He was --
Was he singing opera, you mean, or --
